raw.storage: MATLAB -v7 MAT files, one independent environment group per file; scipy.io.loadmat reader; no v7.3 implicit axis reversal

H.scale: physical channel including pathloss; no per-file energy normalization

raw.path_statistics: Store at observed time grid; powers sum absolute-squared coefficients across Tx, delays with explicit antenna averaging. Save original shape and merge/path-index caveat. Optional dense path coefficients only for QA, never required to retain all dense antenna coefficients.
raw.legacy_bridge: D0 remains read-only; Nt label forbidden on its receive array. Historical replays explicitly named legacy_audit.

physics.bs_array: 8 identical vertically polarized omni elements, half-wavelength ULA centered along local y; fixed yaw=0, pitch=0, roll=0; put array on layout.tx_array
physics.ue_array: one identical omni element on layout.rx_array
physics.delay_reference: QuaDRiGa use_absolute_delays=true; store seconds and setting explicitly
physics.channel_convention: y_k=sum_j h_k w_j s_j+n_k; H stores row channel, no conjugation on read. Conjugation occurs in beam/precoder construction.
physics.grouping: All four users belong to the same BS layout/environment and synchronized clock. One group is one independent statistical unit. No independent-file CSI concatenation to invent a shared environment.
physics.variable_speed_route: Avoid local get_channels(update_rate) movement-profile vmax bug; explicit dense spatial channel then official track time interpolation/channel interpolation. Validate real-channel interpolation and segment merge in T09; do not patch original QuaDRiGa.
physics.sampling_gate: T09 must measure position/time/speed consistency, Nyquist margin and dense-grid sensitivity; no claim of interpolation-free generation without evidence.

scenario_validity.source: Pinned QuaDRiGa 2.8.1 config/3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS.conf and UMi_NLOS.conf headers (TR38.901 v16.1.0)

window.rule: Construct within one realization and user only. All methods/lengths for a condition share origins starting at19, including 20-frame ablation. Formal stride may be frozen at T18 after measured cache budget; no test-dependent subsampling.

normalization.statistics: one global real mean/std and imaginary mean/std fitted over mixed training records; equal environment contribution when lengths differ; no per-test-speed statistics
normalization.shared_models: same mixed-training normalizer and one set of weights for all conditions
normalization.dedicated_models: also use same D1 mixed-training normalizer to simplify fair scaling; D0 legacy bridge uses separately labeled legacy stats
normalization.inverse: predictions always inverse-transformed before physical metrics/link use; preserve normalizer hash and train environment IDs

neural.history: torch float32 [B,L,Nt,Nf,2], normalized with frozen train stats
neural.conditions: optional float tensor[B,2] columns [current_speed_kmh,horizon_ms]; raw units; conditioned model scales by [300,4] internally. tau-only must ignore speed entirely. No future actual speed/CSI.
neural.fit: runner owns train/validation loop, optimizer, sampler and resume; modules have no import-time file IO/training
neural.batch_isolation: During evaluation each row may depend only on its own observed history/known conditions; replacing other batch rows must not change its prediction. In particular prohibit mean-over-batch learned graphs that can expose later forecast origins.
neural.prediction_adapter: runner predicts with one checkpoint, inverse normalizes to complex64 physical CSI, caches with full row keys and status; rejects nonfinite without dropping samples

classical.record: dict with H complex[T,U,Nt,Nf], time_s[T], metadata including split/environment/realization/user_group IDs
classical.config: includes history_length,horizon_steps and preselected method settings; fit must reject records whose split is not train
classical.history: complex physical [B,L,Nt,Nf] oldest_to_newest; no target argument
classical.horizon_override: integer h>=1 for shared mixed-training deployment; no new fit on unknown-speed test data
classical.precision: complex128/float64 internal fitting and metrics; save float64 fitted parameters. Explain loading and conditioning. Do not silently cast legacy AR fit to float32.
classical.baseline_status: Empirical finite-history LMMSE, featurewise AR-Kalman and temporal ESPRIT are declared adaptations, not full multidimensional oracle implementations.
classical.failures: predefined persistence fallback plus explicit status/diagnostics; never remove failed rows from summary

core_api.complex_to_ri: complex ndarray -> real ndarray with final dimension2, preserve precision
core_api.ri_to_complex: real ndarray final dimension2 -> complex ndarray, reject malformed/nonfinite
core_api.window_indices: (n_time,history_length,horizon_steps,origin_start=19,stride=1)->(history_indices[B,L],target_indices[B]); synthetic short fixtures must explicitly pass a smaller valid origin, None forbidden
core_api.build_windows: (record,history_length,horizon_steps,origin_start=19,stride=1)->dict(X,Y,rows); X/Y are physical RI arrays, grouped users, row IDs; no cross-record concatenation; explicit smaller origin only for labeled fixtures
core_api.Normalizer: transform(ri),inverse(ri),to_dict(); immutable statistics and deterministic sha256 property
core_api.aggregate_metrics: list of per-environment metric dicts -> dict(mean_environment_nmse_db,pooled_nmse_db,n_environments,n_invalid); invalid counted and mean not silently recomputed on surviving subset
core_api.paired_bootstrap: (differences[S,E],n_bootstrap=2000,seed=...)->dict(mean,ci_low,ci_high,n_seeds,n_environments); resample seed and environment axes as crossed factors, not S*E independent observations; support S=1

metrics.primary_aggregation: pool time/subcarrier/antenna/user energies within environment first, then10log10 per environment, then equal-weight environment average; seed axis separate
metrics.zero_target: status=zero_target_energy; NMSE/correlation undefined NaN; never floor away or silently filter
metrics.zero_prediction: positive target: NMSE=1,dB=0; correlation undefined NaN with explicit status, deployment fallback defined by link
metrics.exact_prediction: NMSE=0,dB=-inf without residual clipping; explicit perfect_prediction status; serializers must preserve special-value status
metrics.nonfinite: raise ValueError at numerical API boundary; run failure with counted rows, never drop samples

prediction_cache.format: NPZ shards complex64 physical prediction, row index table, metadata JSON; lossless compression only
prediction_cache.rule: Do not replace complex predictions with averages. Shard to bound RAM; storage/stride frozen before formal test. No silent float16 quantization.

link.input: true_future and prediction [B,U,Nt,Nf] complex physical; transpose each subcarrier to H[U,Nt]
link.channel_scale: single positive scalar g=sqrt(mean(abs(H_train)^2)) from mixed D1 train, no centering; evaluate H/g and prediction/g. g common across all models/test conditions, recorded separately from RI normalizer.
link.noise_variance: 10^(-snr_db/10), circular CN(0,variance); SNR is nominal referenced to training per-element channel power, not per-test-row received SNR
link.rzf: V=Hhat^H solve(Hhat Hhat^H + alpha I,I), alpha=U*noise_variance/P; same Frobenius normalization
link.zero_fallback: MU all-zero precoder uses first U columns of identity scaled sqrt(P/U); SU zero prediction uses e1. Record fallback fraction. Rank-deficient ZF uses Moore-Penrose solution; do not drop group.
link.se: SINR on true_future, equal independent unit-energy user symbols; sum log2(1+SINR) over users, mean over subcarriers, bps/Hz
link.ber: uncoded Gray QPSK and16QAM, unit symbol energy; receiver knows current effective desired diagonal channel, scalar equalizer and nearest constellation decision; MU interference included; common symbols/noise for methods
link.approximation: block fading per OFDM symbol, no ICI; pilot/feedback/CP/scheduling overhead not included; perfect CSI reference is same-precoder reference, not capacity bound

test_runner: python -m unittest discover -s revision/tests -v; scientific interpreter from runtime.json
formal_test_gate_source: AI_REVISION/state.json.gates is the sole live authority, read-only to runners; only root writes it. Require exact boolean types for formal_protocol_frozen and formal_test_opened, plus valid formal freeze hash. Never coerce explanatory strings to booleans.
formal_test_gate_rule: T18 freezes protocol, T25 registers opening after prerequisite tasks; T19/T20 physical/file QA only. This contract default is a policy, not a second live gate.
